signing.reading: Every commit object carries one signature, made by the hosting service the agents' sessions run in, with a key that is the same for every agent: it shows the commit came through that service and was not altered after, and GitHub marks it Verified. It does not say WHICH agent: that is only the Agent: trailer, a line of text any pusher could write. No commit, tag or release is signed with an agent's own key from data/keys.json. The version tags are lightweight: names for commits, with no signature. The proposal: ci/signing.md.
